audit: Independent source topology and saved actual geometry audit plus finite subjective render review

qualitative.body_attachment: Improved: relief visibly continues from body faces, with no separately placed components.
qualitative.change_from_bold: Broader overlapping relief occupies previously quiet panels and ties isolated buds into larger folds.
qualitative.remaining_tradeoff: Some broad parent planes are obscured. Overlapping ridges can read as thick crust or terraced facets; branch and fold hierarchy is still weak.
qualitative.recommendation: Use INTEGRATED as the next bounded close-detail lead; preserve BOLD as a lower-density comparison.
qualitative.completion: PARTIAL: stronger attached geometric detail, not a completed Hansmeyer or Digital Grotesque level of continuous multiscale hierarchy.

caveats: CONTROL/G4 and G5 variants share cameras but render pixel sizes differ; this is a subjective geometric comparison, not an image metric.
Negative collars intentionally move some controls inward; the displacement bound is not an outward-only claim.
Single connected closed topology does not imply absence of self-intersections; intersections were excluded at user request.
